provenance.construction: 24 independently authored synthetic family pairs with typed distractors. All tool contracts are original API-Bank schemas.
provenance.complete_variants: Each complete variant appends one explicit value for the otherwise unsupported required argument and retains the distractor.
provenance.fixation: Authored and frozen before any model inference on these tasks. No prompt content from the V3 confirmation set is supplied to memory formation.
